title: Guarded Configuration Predicate
statement: For a word $x\in\{0,1\}^*$, natural numbers $B,P$, and machine configuration $c$, $G(x,B,P,c)$ holds exactly when the first component of $c$ satisfies the guard predicate for the program $Ad(K_0)$ on input $x$ with bound $B$, and the pointer in the memory component of $c$ lies between $0$ and $P$, inclusive.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions of $GuardLe$ and $Ad$, so their specific mathematical meaning is unavailable.
